strongest_objection: Perfect negative correlation might be read as evidence of inhibition or as a prediction for complete spike activity. The upper finite display might also be mistaken for a globally linear biological map.
objection_resolution: The chapter limits the calculation to local expected-rate changes from one shared displacement and explicitly rejects the inhibition inference. The figure legend says common position change only, the caption calls the lines a local guide example, and the preceding chapter paragraph excludes extra private/shared noise and large-displacement or threshold uses. No wiring or time-evolving tuning curve is drawn.
